label: Grassland
description: Open-country landforms as hero subjects — savanna, prairie, steppe, tundra. Prime wildlife habitat.

items.name: acacia-savanna
items.text: an umbrella acacia flat-topped over red-gold savanna grass, end-of-dry-season dust hazing the herds beyond

items.name: tallgrass-prairie
items.text: tallgrass prairie in high summer, bluestem head-high and heavy with seed, wind waves rolling to the horizon

items.name: steppe-shadows
items.text: treeless shortgrass steppe running unbroken to the horizon, cloud shadows racing across it faster than anything on the ground

items.name: termite-cathedral-plain
items.text: red cathedral termite mounds studding the grassland like standing stones, all aligned along the same axis

items.name: autumn-tundra
items.text: autumn tundra burning red and orange at ankle height, dwarf birch and bearberry turned, first snow dusting the far ridge

items.name: chalk-downland
items.text: sheep-cropped chalk downland rolling in green whale-backs, a bare white path curving over the crest

items.name: pampas-plumes
items.text: silver pampas plumes nodding head-high over wind-flattened grass, backlit into soft fire

items.name: dew-web-meadow
items.text: a rough autumn meadow strung with hundreds of dew-loaded orb webs sagging between the seed heads

items.name: postfire-green-flush
items.text: savanna two weeks after a grass fire, a flush of green regrowth spreading across the black burn scar, the first grazers already working the new blades
